name: Inquisitor Divine Infiltrator
body:
A pious operative insinuates herself into enemy cults to subtly weaken and ultimately destroy the misguided devotion of those cultists. A pious operative adds Disable Device, Knowledge (local), and Linguistics to her list of class skills, and removes Intimidate, Knowledge (nature) and Ride.

This alters class skills.

Cunning Defense (Ex)

A pious operative is proficient with all simple weapons, the favored weapon of her deity, and with her choice of one of the following: fighting fan, kama, kusarigama, nunchaku, sai, shortbow, short sword, shuriken, siangham, or wakizashi.

A pious operative is proficient with light armor but not with shields. At 1st level, a pious operative applies a +1 dodge bonus to her armor class if her Wisdom modifier is +1 or greater. At 4th level, and every four levels thereafter, this bonus increases by +1 as long as the pious operative’s Wisdom modifier is equivalent to or greater than the bonus.

For example, an 8th level pious operative with a 15 Wisdom (+2 modifier) would receive a +2 dodge bonus to AC, whereas an 8th level pious operative with a 16 Wisdom (+3 modifier) would receive a +3 dodge bonus. The maximum bonus granted is +6 at 20th level (providing the pious operative’s Wisdom modifier is +6 or greater). Furthermore, a pious operative wearing light armor reduces the armor’s armor check penalty by a number of points equal to 1/2 her Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). A pious operative loses her dodge bonus to AC if she wears medium or heavy armor.

This alters weapon and armor proficiency.

Sneaking Around (Ex)

At 1st level, a pious operative receives a competence bonus equal to 1/2 her level (minimum +1) on Stealth checks and on Disable Device checks when opening locks.

This replaces stern gaze.

Blending In (Ex)

At 2nd level, a pious operative gains a +4 bonus to Disguise checks when attempting to pass herself off as a native language speaker. She also gains one language of her choice. At 4th, 6th, 8th, 10th, and 12th level, a pious operative gains 1 additional language.

This replaces track.

Divine Vessel (Su)

At 3rd level, a pious operative gains a pool of ki points, divinely gifted energy that she can use to accomplish amazing feats. The number of points in a pious operative’s ki pool is equal to 1/2 her pious operative level + her Wisdom modifier. As long as a pious operative has at least 1 point in her ki pool, she is treated as having the Improved Monster Lore feat.

If the pious operative possesses levels in another class that grants points to a ki pool, pious operative levels stack with the levels of that class to determine the total number of ki points in the combined pool, but only one ability score modifier is added to the total. The choice of which score to use is made when the second class ability is gained, and once made, the choice is set. The pious operative can now use ki points from this pool to power the abilities of every class she possesses that grants a ki pool.

As a swift action, by spending 1 point from her ki pool, a pious operative can make a cunning assault for a number of rounds equal to 1 + her Wisdom modifier (minimum 1).

When making a cunning assault, a pious operative is guided by the sagacity of her deity, using her Wisdom modifier in place of her Strength modifier on her attack and damage rolls.

A pious operative can gain additional powers that consume points from her ki pool by selecting certain operative gambits. In all other ways, and for the purposes of meeting prerequisites and qualifying for feats, this ability functions as the ninja class feature ki pool.

This replaces solo tactics and stalwart.

Operative Gambits (Ex and Su)

As a pious operative continues her training, her ability to confound her foes and gain advantage over them increases.

Starting at 3rd level, and again at 6th level and every three levels thereafter, a pious operative can select one ninja trick from those available to a ninja. (A pious operative never gains access to master tricks.) In all other ways, and for the purposes of meeting prerequisites and qualifying for feats, this ability counts as the ninja tricks class feature.

This, in conjunction with divine vessel, replaces all teamwork feats.

Tongues (Sp)

At 14th level, a pious operative is considered to be constantly under the effects of tongues.

This replaces exploit weakness.
